ideas.pitch: An interactive web app for automated chemical process calculations and mass-energy balancing designed for engineering students.
ideas.problem_statement: Evaluate fundamentals of Chemical Process Calculations.
ideas.title: ChemoSolve Process Calculator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core evaluation objective of the MNNIT Allahabad mentorship assessment, appealing to academic judges who want to see engineering rigor combined with practical software tools.

ideas.pitch: A browser-based visualization tool for computing pressure drops, Reynolds numbers, and friction factors in complex pipe networks.
ideas.title: FluidSim Pipeline Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a specific pedagogical pain point in fluid mechanics courses by making abstract textbook calculations interactive and verifiable.

ideas.pitch: A thermodynamic property calculator and cycle simulator for Rankine, Brayton, and refrigeration cycles.
ideas.title: ThermoState Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to professors and student mentors evaluating internship readiness by automating tedious steam table lookups and efficiency calculations.

ideas.pitch: A simulation sandbox for batch, CSTR, and PFR reactors to analyze conversion rates, residence times, and temperature profiles.
ideas.problem_statement: Strengthen knowledge of Chemical Reaction Engineering.
ideas.title: KineticLab Reactor Model
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges the gap between theoretical chemical kinetics and applied problem-solving, fitting the core theme of the MNNIT Allahabad evaluation.

ideas.pitch: A process control simulator for tuning PID controllers, analyzing step responses, and evaluating stability criteria like Bode plots.
ideas.problem_statement: Assess concepts of Process Control and Process Equipment Design.
ideas.title: ControlLoop PID Tuner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on process control—a notoriously difficult subject for chemical engineering students—providing an intuitive tool that judges will immediately recognize as useful.
